task_name: AI-Guided Inverse Design for Recyclable Vitrimeric Polymers

molecular_dynamics.role: Provide initial Tg predictions from MD simulations
molecular_dynamics.output: MD-simulated Tg values with uncertainty estimates

gaussian_process_calibration.role: Calibrate MD predictions to experimental Tg values
gaussian_process_calibration.output: Calibrated Tg predictions with uncertainty quantification

graph_variational_autoencoder.role: Generate novel vitrimer chemistries targeting desired Tg
graph_variational_autoencoder.input: Training data (vitrimer SMILES), target Tg conditions
graph_variational_autoencoder.output: Generated molecular SMILES with predicted properties
